$schema_note: Single source of truth for visual values. Web reads these as CSS custom properties; Android maps them into the Compose theme. Units: px for web, dp for Android.

primary.use: primary buttons, active nav, key accents

accentGold.use: sparingly: highlights, the heart mark, favorites

warning.use: missed medication, needs attention, not red

danger.use: falls and urgent red flags only

darkMode.note: Phase 2. Do not ship until light mode is approved.

typography.fontFamilyArabic: Noto Naskh Arabic, IBM Plex Sans Arabic, system-ui, sans-serif

motion.reduceMotion: respect OS setting; no decorative animation

rules: No people, faces, elderly figures, illustrations of people, medical crosses, hospital imagery, or clinical red/green alarm styling.
No neon colors and no gradients. Flat surfaces only.
Notes are append-only. There is never an edit action on a saved note, only add correction.
The AI never decides safety. Red flags are shown exactly as the backend provides them.
Medication items in plan suggestions are read-only.
Every interactive element is at least 48 px (web) / 48 dp (Android).
Do not invent an Arabic or English brand name. Use the placeholder [APP NAME - supplied by owner].
Do not invent screens or components beyond those listed.
